paragraphs: Ross Stores has reached the end of its plan for new stores this year. The American company opened 51 stores in September and October. With these openings, it reached a total of 115 new stores in its fiscal year 2026. A fiscal year is the twelve months a company uses for its accounts and plans. This marks the completion of its plan for the year.

Ross is an off-price retailer. That means it sells products from famous brands at lower prices. The company says buyers continue to look for brand-name goods at lower prices. Ross wants to give these buyers affordable choices.

The new stores opened under the company's two names. Ross added 41 Ross Dress for Less stores and 10 dd's Discounts stores. They are spread across 17 states. The openings came in two consecutive months, and they show a steady pace of growth.

Some of the openings took the company to new places. Ross Dress for Less opened its first stores in Massachusetts, a new destination for the brand. Furthermore, it added more stores in New York and in other markets where it already works. Meanwhile, dd's Discounts kept growing in its core markets of California, Florida and Texas.

Richard Lietz, an executive vice president at Ross, spoke about the openings. He said each new store lets the company bring good value to more customers. Furthermore, he said the stores create new jobs and have a positive effect on local communities.

The company also showed its involvement in those communities. It gave support to local Boys & Girls Clubs and to reading programs with First Book. The company did not say how much this involvement cost.

After this year's openings, Ross Dress for Less and dd's Discounts together have about 2,377 stores. They are in 45 states, as well as the District of Columbia, Guam and Puerto Rico. That is a considerable number of shops for one company.

Moreover, Ross believes it can grow much larger, and it plans to pursue that growth. It aims to have at least 2,900 Ross Dress for Less stores and 700 dd's Discounts stores one day. The company did not give a date by which it will pursue these goals. Moreover, it did not say how many stores it will open next year. Still, with the completion of this year's considerable plan, Ross now brings affordable shopping to more places than before.
